proposed_extraction_sequence.name: LegacyUptrendInputBoundary
proposed_extraction_sequence.purpose: Identify normalized market, regime, universe, account, holdings, and gate inputs consumed by the legacy UPTREND path.

proposed_extraction_sequence.name: LegacyCandidateSnapshotExtractor
proposed_extraction_sequence.purpose: Capture the exact legacy candidate set before ranking or strategy selection.

proposed_extraction_sequence.name: LegacyRankingAndTop3Boundary
proposed_extraction_sequence.purpose: Capture exact Leader Score ordering, filters, tie behavior, EntryTopN semantics, and the distinction between entry candidates and holdings.

proposed_extraction_sequence.name: LegacyOrderIntentExtractor
proposed_extraction_sequence.purpose: Extract pre-gate BUY, ADD, HOLD, REDUCE, and EXIT intents without executing or mutating the account.

proposed_extraction_sequence.name: MarketGateConsumptionBoundary
proposed_extraction_sequence.purpose: Reuse the R15 contract: block BUY and ADD only when market_entry_allowed is false.

proposed_extraction_sequence.name: LegacyPositionSizingBoundary
proposed_extraction_sequence.purpose: Extract exact legacy quantity and cash-allocation semantics after intent selection.

proposed_extraction_sequence.name: PendingOrderAndExecutionBoundary
proposed_extraction_sequence.purpose: Separate signal-day decisions from T+1 adverse execution, transaction costs, and slippage.

proposed_extraction_sequence.name: AccountMutationBoundary
proposed_extraction_sequence.purpose: Keep fills, cash mutation, position mutation, equity updates, and trade closure outside UptrendCore decision generation.
